title: Amazon GuardDuty or Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Cloud Threat Detection Compared
excerpt: GuardDuty is AWS's native threat detection service; Defender for Cloud is Microsoft's cloud security platform covering Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. Your cloud footprint largely decides between them.
verdict: GuardDuty is the clearer, simpler choice if your workloads are mostly on AWS. Defender for Cloud fits better when you run several clouds and want unified posture management and threat protection across them.
